study type: Multicenter prospective randomized controlled open clinical trial
cohort: 668 women with a singleton gestation of at least 37 weeks who required vacuum assisted delivery
finding: While the disposable cup had more detachments and extraction failures than the standard metallic cup, this innovative disposable device had the advantage of fewer perineal injuries.
mod_finding: The disposable vacuum cup (iCup) had more detachments and extraction failures than the standard metallic cup (Drapier-Faure), but fewer perineal injuries.
